title: fix(studio): copilot composer + collapsible inspector + build→designer bridge
body:
Two UI issues observed in the WYSIWYG Studio design surface on staging (`/_console/studio/…/interfaces`).

## 1. AI 副驾 (copilot) chat was unusable — no composer

The right dock rendered the conversation (Propose blueprint card, Built, assistant message) but showed **no text input at the bottom**, so the user couldn't reply.

Root cause is a broken flex height chain, not a hidden composer. `ChatDockPanel` hosts the injected `ChatPane` in a plain `<div className="min-h-0 flex-1">`. ChatPane's root is `flex min-h-0 flex-1` sized against `maxHeight:100%`, which only resolves against a definite-height flex-column ancestor. The body div is a flex *item* but not itself `flex flex-col`, so ChatPane's height falls back to `auto`, the messages region grows to fit ALL content, and the `shrink-0` composer footer is pushed off the bottom. (Latent in the console rail too — short "ask" threads happened to fit; a long thread overflows the same way.)

**Fix:** make the dock body a bounded flex column (`flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col`), mirroring the working full-page host (`<main className="flex … flex-col">`). Applied to the desktop dock + mobile sheet bodies. No change to ChatPane/ChatbotEnhanced.

## 2. Middle properties inspector should be collapsible

On a wide viewport the inspector is a permanent ~288px right aside (classic and folded-wide layouts), with no way to reclaim the space even when empty.

**Fix:** a collapse toggle — `PanelRightClose` in the inspector header folds it to a thin rail (`PanelRightOpen` to restore), handing the width back to the canvas. In-memory per-mount, gated to the aside layouts (`!showFoldedTabs`); the narrow center-tabs layout already toggles properties as a tab. New i18n keys `inspector.collapse` / `inspector.expand` (EN + ZH).

## Testing
- `type-check` green (turbo, deps built); real `build` (tsc) passes.
- Full app-shell suite green: **1226 tests / 161 files**, incl. `ChatDock.test.tsx` and the `studio-locale.i18n` key-parity test.
- ⚠️ **Not yet pixel-verified in a browser.** Both are layout/render changes; jsdom has no layout engine, and a faithful live render needs the AI-backed console (the local cloud rig serves framework's console, not this objectui). Recommend an eyeball on a preview/staging deploy before merge — #1 especially (a CSS height-chain fix).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## 3. Build → designer bridge (added)
After a build, the AI build page's right pane shows the RUNNING app but had no way to reach the Studio designer (only a close button) — a big part of why the AI-build / Studio / running-app surfaces feel disconnected. Added a "Design in Studio" control to the LiveCanvas header (navigates to `/studio/<pkg>/interfaces`, mirrors the running app's own bridge). Behavioral test added.

_Grounded by actually driving the full flow: "用 AI 搭建" opens a full-screen chat whose right pane is the live running app, not the designer — surfaced the missing bridge._
